title: US removes all bombers from RAF Fairford amid security concerns
summary: The US has removed all its bombers from RAF Fairford, following a security incident under investigation by counter-terror police.
body: The US has removed all its bombers from RAF Fairford, a UK military base at the center of a security incident investigated by counter-terror police, according to BBC News.

A Pentagon official confirmed the relocation of about a dozen B-1s to their home stations in the US, as reported by BBC News. Five British men in their 20s from London were arrested near the base on suspicion of terror offenses, CBS News notes.

A dual UK-Iranian national was later arrested for allegedly plotting a terror attack, CBS News adds. The British government suspects Iran's involvement in the incident, according to CBS News. PBS NewsHour reports that the bombers were used for strikes on Iran.
key_points: US removes all bombers from RAF Fairford due to security concerns.
Five British nationals and a dual UK-Iranian national arrested in connection with the incident.
why_it_matters: The withdrawal highlights heightened security concerns and geopolitical tensions, particularly involving Iran. It also underscores the vulnerability of military bases to potential terror threats.
